<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1236
Claimant:
Richard Smith
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
March 26, 2024
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant is represented by
counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
March 28, 2024
Reviewed the policy record. The driver involved is named on the policy, and coverage was in force at the time of loss.
April 6, 2024
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer's
description of the lane change matches the insured's account.
April 24, 2024
Photos from the scene and the shop show damage that lines up with the described impact. Some details are visible in
the images, but no independent witnesses have come forward.
May 6, 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who outlined neck and back strain as the injuries. The reported injury is plausible
for a collision of this type.
May 11, 2024
Checked prior claims and medical history available to us. No earlier injury to the same body area is known, and no
earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
June 24, 2024
Claimant's account was given again during a follow-up call and matched the earlier statements in every key point.
July 20, 2024
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. Vehicle inspection notes are consistent with a
recent loss.
August 4, 2024
Treatment records received. The care followed a usual course for this type of strain, with physical therapy and
medication.
August 18, 2024
Updated treatment notes show the claimant improving steadily, and the visits have tapered as symptoms eased.
September 15, 2024
File is progressing normally. Remaining items are the final treatment bill and the attorney's settlement demand, and
no coverage questions are open.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
